entries.what: Up at 6:45 and biked to Tamsen Valley for the 8 a.m. General Chemistry midterm, then sat in anatomy at 9 next to Rochelle.
entries.outcome: Finished the chem exam with time to spare and felt okay about it.

entries.what: Worked the Monday 3-9 closing shift at Heron & Grind, logging milk waste and locking the vault-room outlets. Jun and she planned the Halloween menu and she decided to draw skeleton latte art on closing night.
entries.outcome: Settled on the skeleton latte art plan for the Halloween shift.

entries.what: Got home after 9:30 and ate the plate Hạnh left out, then reviewed flashcards in bed.
entries.outcome: Asleep around 12:30.

entries.what: Rode with Kenji to campus for General Chemistry at 11, the last day of midterm week, and ate her packed rice bowl between classes.
entries.outcome: Chem class done and no midterm left to cram for.

entries.what: Went to Pedro's Tuesday 4 p.m. anatomy group at the library and quizzed with his bone models.
entries.outcome: Reviewed the lab practical structures and waited for the posted grades.

entries.what: Planned the week in her paper planner with washi tape and made a lo-fi playlist for studying.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out in color.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 with Dr. Okoye, who said practical grades would be posted Friday.
entries.outcome: Spent the rest of class nervously waiting.

entries.what: Worked the Wednesday 3-9 closing shift at Heron & Grind, charging her e-bike behind the counter. Wes called her 'Doc' at the afternoon rush.
entries.outcome: A busy student crowd and decent tips.

entries.what: Rode home in the dark and finished a flashcard deck review before bed.
entries.outcome: Went to bed on time.

entries.what: General Chemistry at 11, with a ride from Kenji. Thao texted that the St. Anselm nurses union vote was happening and she'd be at the hospital.
entries.outcome: Replied to Thao with a short text and packed lunch was eaten.

entries.what: Studied at Heron & Grind on her day off from the counter, using the vault-wall outlets.
entries.outcome: Caught up on the Statistics online module.

entries.what: Ate dinner with Hạnh, who asked again about pharmacy; Linh steered the talk to the salon.
entries.outcome: Pharmacy talk postponed again.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9: Dr. Okoye posted the practical grades and Linh got a 91, putting her at an A- overall. She asked whether a 91 was good enough and whether the class average was posted.
entries.outcome: Learned she has an A- and that the class average was not posted.

entries.what: Told Pedro and Rochelle her score at lunch, and Rochelle cheered her on.
entries.outcome: Celebrated with a cheap coffee.

entries.what: Stayed home on homecoming night while the stadium filled up, and texted Kenji about the A-.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening in with the planner.

entries.what: Opened Heron & Grind at 6:30 for the Saturday shift, with Jun selling lumpia at the counter.
entries.outcome: Sold out of lumpia by 11 and the shift went fine.

entries.what: Got Sam to cover her last hour since she owed him nothing; he still owes her two Saturdays.
entries.outcome: Left at 1 and rode home on the e-bike.

entries.what: Made a Sunday-prep list and shopped for rice bowl ingredients at Ruiz Family Market, where Kenji rang her up.
entries.outcome: Groceries bought for the week.

entries.what: Worked the Sunday 6:30-1 shift at Heron & Grind.
entries.outcome: A steady crowd and a good rosetta pour.

entries.what: Staffed the front desk at Lotus Nails from 2 to 5 for Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh bragged about her latte art to a customer.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the late afternoon, then planned the week in her planner and prepped rice bowls.
entries.outcome: Ready for the week ahead.
